name: Vlad Dracula
source:
The Prince of Darkness

The grim lord of the castle, a centuries-old vampire. With a silver tongue and an iron grip, he dominates everything around him. Is there anything gentle left within this terrible monster?

Want to find out? Get in Dracula's good graces before his move to England.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1712125696/draculesti]Kickstarter[/url]]
